objective: Initialize fresh reusable repository, Drive hierarchy, durable source library, and validation workflow.
scope: Bootstrap only; no inherited strategy result.
success_condition: PR merged, control/data library created, 20 transcripts registered, revision 1 activated.

objective: Extract and quantify falsifiable alpha hypotheses from the 20 registered transcripts.
scope: Registered sources first; separate mechanism, signal, exit, execution, and sizing.
success_condition: Ranked hypothesis backlog with source IDs, causal boundaries, and minimal experiments.

objective: Enrich source metadata and build a multilingual coverage map.
scope: Titles, creators, dates, entities, topics, and duplicate relationships.
success_condition: Enriched source/entity registry and evidence-based gaps for new search.

objective: Define the first realistic configurable execution and cost baseline.
scope: Fees, spread, slippage, latency, partial fills, funding, liquidity, market impact, and adverse fills.
success_condition: Versioned execution contract with data requirements and sensitivity grid.

objective: Define account-path evaluation and comparable portfolio result format.
scope: NAV, drawdown/recovery, liquidation stress, dependence, concentration, and capital efficiency.
success_condition: Reusable account-level comparator independent of any one strategy.

objective: Audit the fresh harness, provenance, deduplication, and concurrency rules.
scope: Leakage, calculation, execution, stale revisions, shared-state overwrite, and private-data leakage.
success_condition: Actionable defects fixed or invalidated; audit returns project to alpha discovery.
